question: The 2022 Commonwealth Games are scheduled to be held in which of the following countries?
solution:
The correct answer is __**England**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 2022 Commonwealth Games will be held in Birmingham, England.
 
• It is officially known as the XXII Commonwealth Games and is commonly known as Birmingham 2022.
 
• This is the 3rd time England has hosted the Games, after London in 1934 and Manchester in 2002.
 
• 'Games for Everyone' is the motto of the 2022 Commonwealth Games.
 
• The venues being used for the Games are mostly located in Birmingham and a few in Coventry, Royal Leamington Spa, Sandwell, and London.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The first Commonwealth Game in 1930 was hosted in Hamilton, Canada.
 
• Delhi hosted Commonwealth Games in 2010.
